name: Rubik's Cube Star Wars Grogu Cuber
description: The Force is strong with this one. The Rubik’s Cube Star Wars Grogu Cuber combines the classic 3×3 puzzle with an adorable Star Wars twist featuring Grogu, the beloved “Baby Yoda” from The Mandalorian.
features: Official Star Wars Design: Features Grogu’s iconic look from The Mandalorian.
Solve & Display: Attach Grogu’s head and ears to his hover pram for an out-of-this-galaxy display piece.
Classic Rubik’s Challenge: Enjoy the timeless 3×3 twist-and-turn puzzle with a Star Wars upgrade.
Collector’s Favorite: Part of the Rubik’s Cuber Collection — collect The Mandalorian, Grogu, and more.
Perfect Gift Idea: A must-have for Star Wars fans, puzzle lovers, and fidget toy collectors of all ages.
